column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the skirts of His robe” is rendered “the train of His robe.”
Close to the Hebrew; “above him” is rendered “Above it.”
Close to the Hebrew; “foundations of the thresholds” is rendered “the posts of the door.”
Close to the Hebrew; נִדְמֵיתִי (“silenced, ruined”) is rendered “I am undone.”
Close to the Hebrew; “atoned for” is rendered “purged.”
Close to the Hebrew; the infinitive-absolute “hear indeed” is rendered “Keep on hearing.”
Close to the Hebrew; “make fat” is rendered “Make… dull,” and “someone heals it” “be healed.”
Close to the Hebrew; the future “will send far away” is rendered “has removed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “it will be for burning” is rendered “be for consuming,” and “offspring of holiness” “the holy seed.”
